Required_Review_Evidence: Interim workpapers trial balance tie-outs draft bridges
Step_by_Step_Execution: Compile preliminary EBITDA add-back schedules revenue findings and debt registers; verify all workpaper hyper-linking and cross-indexing.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Incomplete audit trail or missing source schedules exposed to cold review challenge.
Concession_Decision_Rule: No findings released externally without primary manager and senior manager review sign-off.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure preliminary items are correctly assigned to EBITDA NWC or Debt buckets without overlap.

Procedure_Name: Independent Quality Review Partner (QRP) Cold Review
Required_Review_Evidence: Complete diligence workpaper file source documents third-party appraisals
Step_by_Step_Execution: Independent QRP reviews sampling sufficiency mathematical footing accounting standard compliance and evidentiary backing of all proposed adjustments.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: QRP flags unevidenced management assertions or aggressive haircut calculations.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Mandatory clearance of all QRP queries before preliminary deliverables are shared with buyer or target.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Audit trail must confirm no double-counting between normalization bridges and debt schedules.

Procedure_Name: Technical Review Challenge Log Issuance & Clearance
Required_Review_Evidence: Formal QRP query log primary team written responses supplemental evidence
Step_by_Step_Execution: Log QRP queries in audit register; require engagement team to gather supplemental contracts or re-foot schedules; record final partner clearance.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Unresolved technical queries weaken report credibility in sponsor committee or arbitration.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Finding cannot be presented in draft report until QRP query is formally marked CLEARED in log.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Verify that resolving a QRP query does not alter previously tied-out balance sheet bridges.

Procedure_Name: Buyer Deal Team Alignment & Negotiation Triage
Required_Review_Evidence: Preliminary issues deck EBITDA bridge net debt register valuation model
Step_by_Step_Execution: Present preliminary diligence findings to private equity investment committee; categorize items into non-negotiable accounting errors vs commercial negotiating levers.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Sponsor pushes to waive valid adjustments to preserve deal momentum or demands unsupported price cuts.
Concession_Decision_Rule: FDD team upholds independent baseline; client-waived items documented separately under AICPA CS 100.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Confirm sponsor commercial concessions do not contaminate audited balance sheet settlement schedule.

Procedure_Name: Target Pushback Intake & Rebuttal Registry Logging
Required_Review_Evidence: Target CFO rebuttal memos markups of draft bridges supplemental VDR files
Step_by_Step_Execution: Receive formal target pushback; log each contested adjustment into master adjudication register with specific seller arguments and counter-amounts.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Uncontrolled informal email exchanges result in missed counter-arguments or unrecorded concessions.
Concession_Decision_Rule: All seller challenges must be centralized in Master Dispute Register with unique tracking IDs.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Tag each challenged item to verify whether pushback affects EBITDA NWC or Net Debt.

Required_Review_Evidence: Pushback defense binder certified appraisals customer contract terms
Step_by_Step_Execution: Conduct formal technical session with Target CFO and sell-side advisors; present audit evidence supporting haircuts; record target verbal representations.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Heated verbal disputes leading to premature verbal concessions under aggressive banker pushback.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Strict adherence to 'No Verbal Concessions' protocol; all adjustments deferred to formal partner review.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure no off-the-cuff agreements blur the boundary between working capital and debt-like items.

Required_Review_Evidence: Newly provided contracts SOWs freight riders tax filings engineering logs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Forensically audit new documents provided during pushback; verify execution dates third-party independence and operational validity.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Seller provides self-serving internal memos or non-binding draft agreements as pushback evidence.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Reject unexecuted drafts or internal assertions; accept only signed binding third-party documentation.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Verify that new documents do not reclassify an operating expense into an unaccrued liability.

Required_Review_Evidence: Master dispute register evidence files benchmark comp databases
Step_by_Step_Execution: Apply Gate 1 (Accounting Standard Breach) Gate 2 (Documentary Evidence) and Gate 3 (Commercial Estimation Range) to adjudicate disputes.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Arbitrary compromise splitting the difference without underlying factual or mathematical support.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Zero concession on Gate 1 errors; calibrate Gate 2/3 adjustments strictly against newly verified facts.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Verify post-adjudication tripartite firewall to ensure no double-recovery across transaction pillars.

Required_Review_Evidence: Preliminary bridges adjudication rulings revised valuation models
Step_by_Step_Execution: Recalculate Normalized EBITDA Enterprise Value Net Debt and Equity Value bridges incorporating adjudicated concessions; prove exact mathematical footing.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Mathematical discrepancies between conceded EBITDA and resulting purchase price bridge.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Preliminary haircut less accepted concessions must equal final adjudicated haircut to the exact cent.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Re-run comprehensive tripartite firewall check across all financial statements and transaction bridges.

Required_Review_Evidence: Draft MRL schedule of unadjusted items target officer signature blocks
Step_by_Step_Execution: Draft engagement-specific MRL detailing all financial data provided adjustments accepted and unadjusted items; obtain signed letter from Target CEO and CFO.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Target management refuses to sign representations regarding unrecorded liabilities or side agreements.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Closing deliverable cannot be released in final form without executed MRL from target executive officers.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: MRL must explicitly represent completeness of AP PTO and all off-balance sheet liabilities.

Required_Review_Evidence: Executed LOI SPA draft Exhibit B GAAP policy documentation
Step_by_Step_Execution: Draft specific accounting definitions for Closing Net Working Capital Target Peg and Debt-Like Items; establish agreed methodologies and collars.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Ambiguous SPA definitions allowing seller to manipulate closing balance sheet true-up calculations.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Ensure SPA specifies whether working capital follows historical target GAAP or modified diligence GAAP.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Verify that every debt-like deduction is explicitly listed in SPA Section 2.5(d) exclusion schedule.

Required_Review_Evidence: Master workpapers tie-out schedules third-party evidence MRL
Step_by_Step_Execution: Assemble comprehensive audit defense binder; apply standardized alphanumeric indexing (`SRC` `PREP` `REC` `ADJ` `DEBT` `ARB`); cross-reference to general ledger.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Missing document links or broken cross-references expose findings to challenge during arbitration.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Every schedule must possess an unambiguous audit trail from raw source document to final bridge.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure cross-reference tags confirm independent non-overlapping treatment across all three pillars.

Procedure_Name: Vendor AP Stretched Trade Credit Audit & Rebuttal
Required_Review_Evidence: AP aging reports vendor payment terms vendor credit hold letters
Step_by_Step_Execution: Audit AP past due >60 days; verify vendor credit hold notices and cash flow suppression; calculate normalized trade credit terms.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Target claims stretched payables are standard industry supplier trade credit rather than cash drag.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Maintain debt-like classification if vendor placed account on hold or payment days exceed 60 days.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure stretched AP balance is deducted from Net Debt and fully excluded from Delivered NWC.

Procedure_Name: Machinery Deferred Maintenance & CapEx Backlog Audit
Required_Review_Evidence: Equipment maintenance logs third-party vibration analysis OEM service quotes
Step_by_Step_Execution: Inspect machine maintenance histories; evaluate OEM recommended overhaul intervals; assess mechanical failure risk and production downtime.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Management claims maintenance was deferred for operational convenience without asset impairment.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Concede only if seller performs pre-close overhaul or proves OEM warranty covers required rebuild.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure deferred maintenance is treated as Debt-Like item or purchase price escrow not in NWC.

Procedure_Name: SaaS Deferred Revenue Fulfillment Cost Audit
Required_Review_Evidence: AWS hosting bills customer SLA agreements engineering support logs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Audit direct infrastructure and support costs required to deliver contracted software services; calculate fulfillment cost percentage under ASC 805.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Target argues deferred revenue carries zero delivery cost and belongs entirely in working capital.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Concede only pre-paid pass-through third-party software licenses; retain direct delivery cost as debt.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Ensure deferred revenue fulfillment cost is deducted as Debt-Like and excluded from operating NWC.

Required_Review_Evidence: Executed SPA Closing Statement Notice of Disagreement referee briefs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Prepare technical position paper for independent accounting referee (e.g. BDO/Grant Thornton); assemble contemporaneous diligence evidence.
Challenged_Pushback_Risk: Independent referee splits the difference due to ambiguous workpaper evidence or weak GAAP support.
Concession_Decision_Rule: Position paper must demonstrate strict adherence to SPA Exhibit B accounting hierarchy.
Tripartite_Firewall_Check: Re-prove to referee that contested item does not double-count against another closing adjustment.
